description: This file defines the AuthenticationSubscriber class, which manages authentication-related events in the OrangeHRM system. It subscribes to kernel request, controller, and exception events to handle user session validation, expiration, and access control by interacting with the user session and redirecting or throwing exceptions as needed.

classes.name: AuthenticationSubscriber
classes.description: Handles authentication-related event subscriptions and logic for session management, user validation, and redirects within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns array of subscribed kernel events and their handler methods, setting up the subscriber to listen for request, controller, and exception events.

methods.name: onRequestEvent
methods.description: Checks if the user is authenticated during the request; stops propagation if not authenticated.

methods.name: onControllerEvent
methods.description: Validates the authenticated user, handles session expiry, and throws appropriate exceptions or redirects depending on controller type.

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Handles session expired or unauthorized exceptions by redirecting to login or returning error responses.

methods.name: getControllerInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the controller instance from the event.

methods.name: getSystemUser
methods.description: Fetches the system user object based on the current authenticated user's ID.

methods.name: isLoggedInUserActive
methods.description: Checks if the user is not deleted and has active status.

methods.name: resolveAuthenticatedUserException
methods.description: Determines if there is an exception condition based on user status, employment, termination, or existence.

methods.name: hasUserLastModifiedChanged
methods.description: Detects if the user's last modification date has changed since last session.

methods.name: refreshUserLastModified
methods.description: Updates the session with the latest last modified timestamp of the user.

methods.name: getUserLastModifiedValue
methods.description: Returns the formatted last modified date of the user, or null if unavailable.

methods.name: logoutCurrentSession
methods.description: Invalidates the current session, marks the user as unauthenticated, and sets flash messages for login errors.
